mapper.insert: INSERT INTO counseling_reservation (trainee_id, trainer_id, training_id, schedule_id, status, room_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{traineeId}, #{trainerId}, #{trainingId}, #{scheduleId}, #{status}, #{roomId}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT cr.reservation_id, cr.trainee_id, cr.trainer_id, cr.training_id, cr.schedule_id, cr.status, cr.room_id, ts.start_time, ts.end_time, trainer.name as trainer_name, trainee.name as trainee_name, t.title as training_title, cr.created_at FROM counseling_reservation cr JOIN trainer_schedule ts ON cr.schedule_id = ts.schedule_id JOIN user trainer ON cr.trainer_id = trainer.user_id JOIN user trainee ON cr.trainee_id = trainee.user_id JOIN training t ON cr.training_id = t.training_id WHERE cr.trainee_id = #{traineeId} ORDER BY ts.start_time DESC

SELECT cr.reservation_id, cr.trainee_id, cr.trainer_id, cr.training_id, cr.schedule_id, cr.status, cr.room_id, ts.start_time, ts.end_time, trainer.name as trainer_name, trainee.name as trainee_name, t.title as training_title, cr.created_at FROM counseling_reservation cr JOIN trainer_schedule ts ON cr.schedule_id = ts.schedule_id JOIN user trainer ON cr.trainer_id = trainer.user_id JOIN user trainee ON cr.trainee_id = trainee.user_id JOIN training t ON cr.training_id = t.training_id WHERE cr.trainer_id = #{trainerId} ORDER BY ts.start_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM counseling_reservation WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId} AND status != '취소'

SELECT cr.reservation_id, cr.trainee_id, cr.trainer_id, cr.training_id, cr.schedule_id, cr.status, cr.room_id, cr.created_at, cr.updated_at FROM counseling_reservation cr JOIN trainer_schedule ts ON cr.schedule_id = ts.schedule_id WHERE cr.status = '예약완료' AND ts.start_time <= #{currentTime} AND ts.end_time > #{currentTime}

SELECT cr.reservation_id, cr.trainee_id, cr.trainer_id, cr.training_id, cr.schedule_id, cr.status, cr.room_id, cr.created_at, cr.updated_at FROM counseling_reservation cr JOIN trainer_schedule ts ON cr.schedule_id = ts.schedule_id WHERE cr.status = '진행중' AND ts.end_time <= #{currentTime}
